description: Zinal sits at about 1675 metres at the head of the Val de Zinal, with chalets and the chapel of Saint-Barthélemy facing the Imperial Crown. From west to east the five 4000-metre peaks are the Dent Blanche, the Obergabelhorn, the Zinalrothorn, the Weisshorn, and the Bishorn. This is not the wooden street of Grimentz, and the village itself is free of snow. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear and mild, with sun through light cloud and no rain.
